technical.title: Geometry-Aware Token Selection Uses LiDAR to Optimize Vision Autonomous Driving
technical.summary: Geometry-Aware Token Selection (GATS) projects LiDAR and radar points to drop irrelevant image tokens before the vision backbone runs, outperforming dense models by focusing computation on driving-critical content.
technical.why: This method significantly reduces compute overhead and improves efficiency for sparse latent world models in autonomous driving.

technical.title: CalibSwitch Framework Recovers and Maintains Camera-LiDAR Extrinsics
technical.summary: CalibSwitch is an observation-driven framework for mobile robots that separates absolute SE(3) extrinsic recovery from selective state maintenance using cross-modal feature interaction and geometry regularization.
technical.why: Robust camera-LiDAR calibration is essential for maintaining safe and reliable autonomous vehicle perception.

technical.title: TinyAstral Distills Large Teacher Harnesses into Compact Manipulation Agents
technical.summary: TinyAstral introduces a two-stage approach to transfer improvements from a large vision-language model teacher's harness into a compact student agent using recursive self-improvement and trajectory distillation.
technical.why: This technique helps lower inference compute costs for resource-constrained robotics applications.

technical.title: Direct Manifold Action Transformer Improves Bimanual Manipulation Efficiency
technical.summary: The Direct Manifold Action Transformer (DMAT) models clean, observation-conditioned joint-space action chunks directly, bypassing the latency and mismatch introduced by iterative denoising in diffusion visuomotor policies.
technical.why: It offers a faster and more robust approach for bimanual robotic manipulation tasks.

technical.title: ReGap-Bench Exposes Visual Reference Gaps in Multimodal LLM Reasoning
technical.summary: Researchers demonstrate that multimodal LLM counting and reasoning failures stem from a reference gap rather than perception errors. They introduce ReGap-Bench to test whether external visual scaffolds like numbering can help bind language to entities.
technical.why: Understanding this reference gap is crucial for improving multi-step visual reasoning reliability.

technical.title: MAServeBench Evaluates LLM Serving Hardware Bottlenecks for Multi-Agent Workloads
technical.summary: MAServeBench benchmarks multi-agent LLM systems by modeling hierarchical collaboration workloads, capturing how interdependent model and tool operations dynamically alter concurrency, computation, and memory demands on serving hardware.
technical.why: It helps optimize hardware and serving strategies for complex multi-agent system workflows.

technical.title: Zyphra Introduces Hierarchical Attention to Enable Subquadratic LLM Scaling
technical.summary: Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA) uses a tree-indexed sparse attention method, retrofitting frozen LLMs with token distillation to match dense attention models on reasoning and retrieval benchmarks.
technical.why: It offers a pathway to true subquadratic attention for scaling large language models efficiently.

technical.title: Drone-PUR Benchmark Evaluates Vision-Language Reasoning in UAV Scenes
technical.summary: Drone-PUR is a new dataset and benchmark designed to evaluate perception, understanding, and reasoning in unmanned aerial vehicle scenes featuring small targets and changing viewpoints.
technical.why: It provides a rigorous evaluation suite for advancing aerial computer vision systems.

technical.title: OpenVIO Provides Versatile Open-Source Visual-Inertial Odometry System
technical.summary: OpenVIO is a newly released open-source visual-inertial odometry system under the MIT license that supports pinhole, fisheye, and stitched 360-degree cameras for robotics research and applications.
technical.why: It offers a reliable, accessible baseline for spatial tracking in robotics and computer vision research.

technical.title: Study Examines Fault Coupling in Agentic Medical Vision Systems
technical.summary: Researchers test fault coupling in agentic dermatology systems where vision-language reasoners share common visual faults with tools like segmentation, showing how typographic injection causes detectable errors.
technical.why: Highlighting shared channel failures helps improve safety and robustness in medical AI agents.

business.title: Omen AI acquires Aquatic Labs for $16 million
business.summary: Two startups tackling the data center water problem are joining forces in a $16 million deal, combining Omen AI and Aquatic Labs.
business.why: Data center infrastructure costs directly impact the scalability and economics of large AI deployments.

business.title: South Korea targets sovereign AI model in new budget
business.summary: The 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, including a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.
business.why: National investments in semiconductors and physical AI create regional market opportunities and hardware demands.

business.title: Companies report AI boosting revenue and improving profitability
business.summary: Santander, Novartis and other companies say AI is beginning to boost revenue, cut costs or improve profitability as investors seek returns.
business.why: Enterprise software adoption trends validate the commercial return on investment for large-scale AI integration.

business.title: Venture funding concentrates in massive AI rounds
business.summary: Record venture funding in 2026 has been increasingly concentrated in massive AI rounds, while seed- and early-stage deal counts decline, according to Crunchbase data.
business.why: Funding trends dictate the availability of capital for early-stage infrastructure and autonomous driving startups.

business.title: Trajectory raises $45 million at a $300 million valuation
business.summary: The one-year-old startup Trajectory has raised $45 million to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts, bringing its valuation to $300 million.
business.why: New tools lowering the barrier to model training change how engineering teams approach dataset management.

business.title: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors Program for data centers
business.summary: OpenAI will pilot its Grid Protectors Program at an upcoming data center in Effingham County, Georgia, promising to free up to 1,000 megawatts of power during emergencies.
business.why: Power grid management solutions are increasingly vital for sustaining expanding high-density AI data center loads.

business.title: New York Times sues Brave web browser over AI scraping
business.summary: The New York Times and other publications filed lawsuits against the maker of the Brave web browser over alleged unlawful scraping to train AI and bypass paywalls.
business.why: Scraping litigations directly impact the legal frameworks governing training data acquisition for computer vision and LLMs.

business.title: AI coding agents consume significantly more tokens
business.summary: When developers give AI agents coding tasks involving planning, testing, and error correction, a single task can use 10 to 50 times more tokens than a basic prompt.
business.why: Token consumption metrics help engineers budget API costs and infrastructure when deploying autonomous agent loops.

business.title: Apple plans $1,000 home robot for FaceTime and lights
business.summary: An Apple robot backed by CEO John Ternus may launch in 2027 with a hefty price tag and limited uses like FaceTime and switching on lights.
business.why: Consumer robotics hardware developments offer insight into future physical AI integration and edge computing.

business.title: OpenAI signs four Abu Dhabi agreements spanning energy and government
business.summary: OpenAI signed four Abu Dhabi agreements spanning energy, government and investment as Sam Altman met the emirate’s crown prince.
business.why: Global sovereign investments and energy deals shape the geopolitical landscape of AI infrastructure.

models.title: Idol Generates 3D Gaussian Splats From Single Images
models.summary: Idol turns a single image, render, or photo into up to a million 3D Gaussians written as a standard 3DGS .ply file. It runs on consumer GPUs under 2 seconds using 7.2 GB of VRAM.
models.why: It provides rapid single-image 3D reconstruction useful for computer vision workflows.

models.title: Mistral Large 4 Multimodal Model Features 1 Trillion Parameters
models.summary: Mistral Large 4 is a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token. It unifies reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows while surpassing closed models on visual grounding.
models.why: It represents a massive open frontier model with advanced multimodal capabilities and visual grounding.

models.title: Baidu Releases Unlimited OCR 2 for Unlimited-Horizon Document Parsing
models.summary: Unlimited OCR 2 introduces unlimited-horizon parsing using SR-SWA, accompanied by the new MarathonDocBench benchmark for ultra-long document parsing evaluation.
models.why: It advances document parsing technology for ultra-long context vision-language tasks.

models.title: LiquidAI Launches LFM3-Omni-2B End-to-End Omni-Modal Model
models.summary: LFM3-Omni-2B is an on-device omni-modal model that processes text, images, video, and audio simultaneously, answering in text and speech to replace multiple single-task models.
models.why: It delivers joint audio-visual understanding in a small footprint suited for edge devices.

models.title: LiquidAI Releases LFM3-1.7B Text Model for Edge Devices
models.summary: LFM3-1.7B is a text model built on a new tri-hybrid architecture designed for local agents and edge deployment. At 4-bit precision, it consumes about 1 GB of memory, featuring a 256K-token context window and single-GPU fine-tuning support.
models.why: It offers an efficient edge-deployable text model option for resource-constrained environments.

models.title: NVIDIA Launches Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 30B Speech Model
models.summary: Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B is an open-weight, offline speech and audio model supporting transcription in 40 languages. It uses a hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture activating about 4.3B parameters, handling up to one-hour recordings.
models.why: It provides a robust offline transcription tool across multiple languages and long-form audio.
